notes.title: Roadmap Update & Demo Incoming!
notes.content:
Welcome again skyward adventurers!
We know you're eager to get your hands on our explosive bullet heaven action, and today's news post is all about our development journey, where we are now, and what's coming very, very soon!


Our Development Process
Developing Skyfire: Death From Above has been an incredible journey, guided by a clear and structured roadmap. We believe in transparency and want to give you a peek behind the curtain at how we're bringing this game to life.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/4829b90c25ea88c0d22bee2edff2b5f7d9d0d42d.png"]Milestone 0: Laying the Foundation
This was our initial ideation phase, where the design team put forth the core concepts for Skyfire. We sketched first designs, the various enemies you'll face, and the unique abilities your aerial citadel will wield. It was also crucial to get those very first, rough prototypes of the game's core loop up and running – is it fun? Is it engaging? This early stage was all about answering those fundamental questions.
Milestone 1: Mechanics Taking Shape
Building on our core loop, this milestone saw us create a "playground" environment. This wasn't about pretty graphics yet, but about solidifying the foundational mechanics: how your platforms move, how turrets function, and how simple enemies behave. We also started bringing our concepts into 3D, creating the first basic models, and crucially, finalized the core loop design – deciding exactly what the player's moment-to-moment experience would be.
Milestone 2: Defining the Aesthetic & Core Gameplay
This was a pivotal milestone for the game's identity. We created an artistic diorama, a small, highly polished scene, to truly lock down the final visual aesthetic and art style of Skyfire. Simultaneously, our programmers fully implemented and refined the core loop, ensuring it was robust and expandable. This also marked the beginning of proper level design, moving beyond simple test environments.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/6cec6000e76e826ce086d5a667ca42ef0a2490c9.png"]
Milestone 3: Expanding the Battlefield
With the core gameplay locked and the art style defined, this milestone focused on content expansion. We began designing and making multiple levels fully playable, introducing a wider array of abilities and upgrades for your turrets and platforms, and adding more turret types to diversify your defensive strategies. This was also when the very first pieces of final in-game art started to make their way into the game, replacing placeholder assets.
Milestone 4: Boss Battles & Polish Begins
A significant challenge in this phase was adding our first boss level, designing a unique and formidable foe that would test your accumulated skills. We also focused on bringing the first full level (Level 1) to its final art pass, ensuring it looked as incredible as we envisioned. More upgrades and enemy variations were introduced, and a comprehensive tutorial was implemented to welcome new pilots into the fight.




Current Status: Diving Deep into Milestone 5!
As of now, we are in the thick of Milestone 5, the final push towards a truly polished and immersive experience. This is where all the disparate pieces come together, and we refine every detail. Our focus during this crucial period includes:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/3e53a621cdcd5e196ef496eef4aebdc505a859f6.png"]


Get Ready to Take Flight! Demo Release on July 11th!


Mark your calendars, wishlist the game, and prepare for takeoff! We can't wait for you to experience Skyfire: Death From Above firsthand.




Follow us below to be part of the Little Donkey Family🫏

With much love, 
Skyfire: Death From Above Dev Team

notes.title: A Journey Through Our Art
notes.content:
Welcome skyward adventurers! 

Come along through a journey through our art
We're thrilled to pull back the curtain and share a visual journey through the development of Skyfire: Death From Above, showcasing the significant strides we've made in bringing our world to life. Our team has poured their passion into every detail, from initial concepts to the final dressing of our levels, ensuring a truly immersive and visually stunning experience.


Level 1: The Cloudveil Mountains
The player's journey begins amidst the majestic Cloudveil Mountains, where the Restoration fleet's first scouts have been deployed. This level sets the tone for the epic scale of Skyfire, a testament to the imposing presence of the Restoration army.



We began by exploring various concept art iterations to capture the grandeur and natural beauty of these formidable mountains. Our goal was to create an environment that felt both awe-inspiring and foreboding.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/d14f5d429fa1681fff6a580ed1197cb7eaf9aa61.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/5c7505414ae04e083f435ade4df8c955ae344b31.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/dfa1b7e6e0005088c2e96196d11ab7a229f16605.png"]

As you can see, we moved from the foundational shapes of the level blockout to meticulously dressing the environment with detailed elements, truly bringing the Cloudveil Mountains to life.


Level 2: Fallen Factory
From the expansive outdoors, players will descend into the heart of the Restoration army's operations: the Fallen Factory. This is their most valuable and heavily defended stronghold, and we've designed it to reflect that intensity.



Our art direction for this level focused on creating a sense of claustrophobia and danger. We aimed for enclosed spaces with aggressive lighting and a strong emphasis on mechanical elements.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/aa4029963b64c67753aaba4f43f7d98eeb947228.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/558a8b0b63d2d19fe1d381eb25e9f7b7f9c159ed.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/eaf8d0d5aed2cdd1b1b13296ff73d800713f4f14.png"]

The transition from concept to the final, dressed level in the Fallen Factory is dramatic. We've layered in intricate details, from the glow of active machinery to the grime and wear of a working industrial complex. Our design objective for this level was to combine all enemy types, creating the most challenging encounter before the final act.


Level 3: Eye of the Storm
Victorious from the crumbling factory, your castle escapes into the open sky for a final, climactic confrontation. In the Eye of the Storm, the only remaining enemy is another formidable flying castle, allied with the Restoration.



This level is a visual contrast to the claustrophobic factory. Here, the skies are seen in all their expanse, providing a breathtaking backdrop for the ultimate showdown.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/033afe5255369d2ac94339faf45596de93a3db5f.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/45c59b7a1fd8def8a7523a81f0fd2b16675b873a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/f177ee153dfdf29faaa1329b1d202ee162effffe.png"]

The final dressed level showcases the intricate details of the battling castles along with the atmospheric effects. This level is designed to be the ultimate challenge, culminating in a thrilling final boss battle.


A Heartfelt Thanks to our crew!


We hope this visual devlog gives you a taste of the dedication and artistry going into Skyfire: Death From Above. We're incredibly proud of the visual progress we've made, and we can't wait for you to experience all of it. 



None of this would be possible without the incredible hard work, passion, and dedication of our entire team. Every artist, designer, programmer, technical artist, producer, digital marketer, sound designer and contributor has poured their heart and soul into making Skyfire: Death From Above a reality, and we are profoundly grateful for their relentless efforts. Thank you all for bringing our vision to life!



Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and polish every aspect of the game!


Follow us below to be part of the Little Donkey Family🫏

With much love, Skyfire: Death From Above Dev Team

notes.title: The Skies Await: Our Demo Soars in One Month!
notes.content:
Skyward Adventurers, Your Orders Are In: Demo Launches Next Month!


Commanders, mark your calendars! In just one month, our highly anticipated demo will be soaring onto Steam, and we absolutely cannot wait to share it with you! Get ready to pilot your massive aerial fortress into the heart of a perpetual war.



This isn't just a taste; it's a deep dive into the world we've built, showcasing the core of what makes our game tick.

Check out our YouTube Short to celebrate our one month left!

What Awaits You in the Demo?
You'll be able to experience the vital role of your flying fortress – a mobile base for strategy, upgrades, and resource management, truly the centerpiece of your journey. It's your stronghold for exploration and expansion, equipped with powerful turrets to open new territories and defend against relentless enemies.



We're bringing you three intense levels, each designed to challenge your skills and immerse you in our unique world. (And yes, we're still busy dressing them up to look their absolute best for you!)


Level 1: The Cloudveil Mountains
Story: Your journey begins deep in the far mountains, where the first scouts of The Restoration fleet have been deployed. Look out for the colossal facility towers looming in the distance!

Art: Expect majestic mountains and rich natural elements.

Design: We'll introduce enemies and mechanics in isolation, then ramp up the intensity with exciting combinations.

Progression: You'll acquire 0 to 6 random upgrades.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/9bf18ae8cecbe64016482ce0a9e2bd21a0289547.png"]
Level 2: The Fallen Factory
Story: Your castle finally breaches the factory, the very heart and most valuable point of The Restoration army.

Art: Prepare for enclosed spaces, aggressive lighting, and intricate mechanical elements.

Design: This level combines all enemies for the ultimate challenge!

Progression: Expect to earn 7 to 12 random upgrades.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/a9f519fdd74286ca4f9be1fe05ced1d956b7ad96.png"]
Level 3: Eye of the Storm
Story: You've escaped victorious from the crumbling facility. Now, only one formidable foe remains: The Herald, a rival flying castle sided with The Restoration.

Art: Behold the vast expanse of the sky and sea, a stark contrast to the factory's confines, with familiar mountains from Level 1 in the background.

Design: This is the ultimate final boss challenge!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/91241939f1b7e8c514b7fbc213b5fa6ef5201b55.png"]


[hr][/hr]Meet Your Adversaries!
You'll encounter a diverse range of foes designed to test your tactical prowess:

The Herald: A massive rival floating citadel, often more powerful than your own castle, protected by rotating walls with vulnerable laser gun slots. It's the ultimate boss challenge!

Knights: Heavily armed Marauder variants, protected by strong frontal shields that deactivate when they lock onto a target, signaling your window to strike!

Marauders: Light cruisers that deploy swarms of Wasps. They keep their distance, relying on their gliders to harass and overwhelm.

Proximity Mines: Hidden within the surface, these mines go airborne upon detecting your castle, slowly approaching to detonate and deal area damage to you and nearby enemies.

Wasps: Small, agile, unmanned aerial gliders equipped with collision explosives. These kamikaze attackers aim to overwhelm defenses through sheer numbers and speed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/0a61407c690a0cd2e97e687e777f934400c2c661.png"]
[hr][/hr]

Your Castle, Your Survival
Your flying fortress is more than just a base; it's your weapon, shield, and home in this endless war. Its core health bar represents your overall survival, supported by modular turret systems acting as offense and defense. Strategize your module placement and repairs to withstand the onslaught!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/d6d47ef4a3ef37a3a32a1b5d0674bf3bfb123720.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/8edcd113e7b5148c0f784b1a627983fa5e942615.png"]


[hr][/hr]

A World Forged in War
Dive into a rich history where humanity survives above the clouds in floating cities, constantly battling the remnants of a forgotten conflict. Encounter The Restoration, a new enemy from the surface determined to end the sky-dwellers. Our story is told through the environment itself:

Stagnant Technology: A twisted evolution of WWI machinery.

Castle Design: Fortresses that are living fragments of civilization.

Dialogues & Communications: Atmospheric sounds and war hymns that echo the past.

Two ways of life are on a collision course. Will you lead the last strongholds to avenge the fallen and destroy The Restoration's fleet?


[hr][/hr]
Get ready to experience the full scope of our aerial warfare. Add us to your wishlist now and prepare for the demo next month!

Follow us below to be part of the Little Donkey Family🫏

With much love, 
Skyfire: Death From Above Dev Team
